contentText: US President Donald Trump said he was "very angry" to hear from Russian President Vladimir Putin that Ukraine had tried to attack his residence in northern Russia on Monday. Moscow provided no evidence for claims that Ukraine dismissed as baseless and aimed at derailing arduous peace talks. Russia's foreign minister referred to the attack as "state terrorism" and said Russia would review its negotiating stance but not quit the negotiations. Follow our liveblog for updates.
